title: Concept: Total record count returned with a filtered list
description: A total count far above the page size in a list response in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The count turns a filtered search into a measuring tool, so an attacker can confirm how many customers match a guess without reading any of them.
applicability: Deployments that render a total count far above the page size in a list response into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The count turns a filtered search into a measuring tool, so an attacker can confirm how many customers match a guess without reading any of them.
